title: The Case of the Recipe Card
story: Rosa's great-grandmother's cranberry bread recipe, in faded pencil on a card, has hung on the bakery corkboard for years. On Saturday morning it vanished, and Rosa swears even Gloria, her sourdough starter, looks worried. Five customers came in that morning, each at a different time, each ordering something different and sitting somewhere different. The corkboard hangs right beside the window table, out of reach of every other seat. Who pocketed the recipe card?
